chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from al-'Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him about a man who hires an animal, saying, 'I have hired it from you up to such and such a place. If I exceed it, then for you is such and such an increase,' and he specifies that. He (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no problem with all of it.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no problem with it

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to hire an animal with a variable fee based on distance traveled?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi validates the contractual flexibility in *ijarah* (leasing), specifically addressing the permissibility of variable compensation based on actual distance traveled beyond the initial agreement. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that such conditional increments do not constitute *gharar* (excessive uncertainty) or *riba* (usury), provided the terms are clearly stipulated by the owner. The ruling underscores the practical adaptability of commercial contracts in early Islamic society, allowing for equitable remuneration based on usage.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Abu Hamza, 
from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who hires the animal, so he is saying, ‘I am hiring it from you up to such and such a place. So if I were to exceed it, for you would be such and such increase (of hire charges)’, and he specifies that’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with it, all of it’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from al-‘Ala’ from Muhammad ibn Muslim from abu Hamzah who has said the following: “This is concerning my question before abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about the case of a man who rents a stumper and says, ‘I rent it from you to so and so place; if I went beyond such place you will be paid so and so much extra which he mentions.’ He (the Imam) said, ’All of it is permissible.’”
